description.value: A popular BC Parks campground on Ten Mile Lake, 12 km north of Quesnel via Highway 97, with three sandy beaches, showers, flush toilets, rainbow trout fishing, and a 2 km nature trail to a beaver pond; gates close for the off-season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms this is a fee-based campground within Ten Mile Lake Provincial Park (~12 km north of Quesnel on Hwy 97), with showers and flush toilets explicitly listed in the highlights, and a 'Book camping' link plus 'Reservation policies' section confirming reservations are accepted. The OSM operator phone and email are for Silvertip Park Services Ltd. and are not listed on the BC Parks website, so the phone cannot be confirmed. The website's cycling section confirms bikes are permitted on trails, and an e-biking section is referenced but the content was cut off in the fetch.
concerns: The OSM name 'Touring Campground' refers to a specific campground loop within Ten Mile Lake Provincial Park; the linked BC Parks website covers the whole park, so amenity details specific to the touring loop (e.g. hiker/biker sites, site layout) are not distinguishable from the fetched content.
Phone number (+1-250-320-9305) and email (parkinquiries@telus.net) are for operator Silvertip Park Services Ltd. and are not listed or confirmed on the BC Parks website.
The e-biking section on the website was truncated in the fetch; e-bike policy for the park could not be fully assessed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-serviced provincial campground with showers, flush toilets, and online reservations on the Highway 97 corridor in central BC; a clear fit for touring cyclists heading through the Cariboo region.

wow_evidence: showers, flush toilets… 12 km north of Quesnel via Highway 97
